_about: Generic open questions: copy the ones that apply into implementation.json#open_questions, make the context and default site-specific, add the site's own.

questions.question: Should live pages with no sampled traffic in 90 days be migrated, redirected or retired?
questions.context: Retiring them shrinks the migration and the QA surface. Only applies when real-user data exists.
options: Retire and redirect to the parent section
questions.default: Migrate all; flag them for a post-launch review.

questions.question: Should empty pages (header and footer only) be redirected instead of migrated?
questions.context: Typically section roots without content.
options: Redirect to the closest useful page
questions.default: Redirect each to its first child or parent landing page.

questions.question: Are live pages that are not in the sitemap in scope?
questions.context: Found through internal links.
questions.default: In scope when they have traffic; otherwise redirect.

questions.question: Is the EDS URL format (lowercase, no .html) accepted, with redirects for every old URL?
questions.context: One rule covers .html; paths that also change case or characters need explicit entries. Campaign links, QR codes and tag-manager rules use the old paths.
questions.default: EDS format with a .html rule plus explicit redirects.

questions.question: Where should broken legacy redirects and the most-hit 404s point?
questions.context: Existing redirects into dead pages and real-user 404s.
questions.default: The agent proposes the closest live page; unmatched ones stay 404.

questions.question: Which locale trees follow the scoped tree, in what order?
questions.context: Applies to multi-language sites; see the locale inventory.
questions.default: Scoped tree first; the code base is built locale-ready; trees follow by traffic.

questions.question: How is content inheritance between locales (live copies, masters) replaced?
questions.context: EDS document authoring has no live-copy inheritance.
options: Copy at migration, then independent trees
Keep authoring in the CMS that has inheritance
questions.default: Copy at migration; trees become independent; translation via the stakeholder's vendor.

questions.question: Do the EDS hosts use the same tag-manager property (new environment) or a new one?
questions.context: Rules, data elements and custom code live in the property.
questions.default: Same property with a new environment for the EDS hosts, production switched at go-live.

questions.question: Must EDS reproduce the data-layer schema exactly?
questions.context: Data elements read named fields; changing names means editing the tag manager.
questions.default: Same schema, populated from page metadata and block events.

questions.question: Which page-specific campaign rules are still active, and who rewrites their conditions?
questions.context: Rules matching .html paths or DOM selectors break on EDS; rules whose page is gone are retire candidates.
questions.default: The agent produces a rule-by-rule rewrite sheet; the analytics team applies it.

questions.question: Can the EDS hosts be added to the consent platform, and how does it load?
questions.context: The CMP must load before the tag manager and keep the geo rule sets.
questions.default: Direct load in head with the existing configuration; the tag manager gated by consent.

questions.question: Do the analytics collector and report suites carry over unchanged?
questions.context: First-party collectors (CNAMEs) and environment-specific suites.
questions.default: Unchanged in production; a staging suite for the EDS environment.

questions.question: Which form services and form ids are current, and should forms be consolidated?
questions.context: Hosted form vendors and embedded form ids found on pages.
questions.default: Keep every page's form as authored.

questions.question: Where do forms that post to the current CMS submit once it is gone?
questions.context: Server-side form handlers disappear with the CMS.
questions.default: Rebuild the UI with submission disabled and contact details shown until the endpoint is decided.

questions.question: Does the current media delivery (DAM / dynamic media) remain after the CMS is decommissioned?
questions.context: Images and videos referenced from the DAM.
options: Keep the DAM delivery (assets as links)
questions.default: Keep the DAM delivery and author assets as links.

questions.question: Where will linked documents (PDFs, brochures) be hosted?
questions.context: Documents linked from pages; large files exceed EDS media limits.
questions.default: Keep them on the DAM delivery; redirect their paths if they move.

questions.question: Who owns the taxonomy that drives listings, related links and analytics?
questions.context: Tags and categories on pages.
questions.default: A taxonomy sheet plus per-page metadata, seeded from the current tags.

questions.question: Is metadata-based search (query index) acceptable, or is full-text search required?
questions.context: EDS indexes give titles, descriptions and metadata.
questions.default: Query-index search with title-first ranking, checked against the recorded probe counts.

questions.question: Can the stakeholder provide the source or data for client-rendered apps?
questions.context: Components with no server HTML.
questions.default: Snapshot as content where possible; apps wait for the source.

questions.question: Should the migration add structured data?
questions.context: Measure current JSON-LD coverage first.
questions.default: Not in the like-for-like migration; listed as an improvement.

questions.question: Which CDN fronts the EDS site in production?
questions.context: The current CDN and its rules.
questions.default: Bring your own CDN with push invalidation.

questions.question: Who owns the security headers (CSP, HSTS, permissions policy) on the new stack?
questions.context: Today set by the origin.
questions.default: Carry the current headers over, adding the EDS hosts.

questions.question: Are panels with nested blocks inside tabs/accordions authored as fragments?
questions.context: EDS blocks cannot nest.
questions.default: Fragments, one per panel with nested blocks.

questions.question: Is the target pixel parity, or consolidation onto a shared design system?
questions.context: Pixel parity turns many reuse verdicts into variants.
questions.default: Pixel parity on archetypes; small differences consolidated with sign-off.
